guides.favoredWhen: Force extended trades; never let him keep it short or bully you out early.

keyTips.text: You win extended trades. He must avoid the 1v1, so chase every trade past his comfort point instead of letting him hit and leave.
He bullies the lane early. Respect his fourth-shot poke while farming, and answer only with full combos rather than standing trades.
Scaling is roughly even. Neither side gets a free clock, so the lane winner keeps the edge — do not hand him an early lead for nothing.

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Trade while his fourth shot is spent and give ground while he holds it. The loaded shot zones you off the wave even without firing.
Walk up when he wastes Deadly Flourish ({cd:202:W}) dry. Without the follow-up root he has no answer to your slide.
Stick to him with Spark Surge ({cd:221:E}) once the trade starts. Your mobility turns his short-trade plan into the extended fight you win.
Meet his objective groups and force the duel. His W-plus-R plan needs range and setup; your extended damage inside it wins.
Sweep the objective flanks for his traps and fog picks. Denied vision denies his casts, and he cannot set up what he cannot see.
Kite forward through fights, not away. Every extra second of the extended trade favors you over his short-trade plan.
Break vision and stay mobile once his root connects. The instant Curtain Call shot after it is guaranteed unless you are already moving.

itemization.text: Build to extend fights. Your win is the long mobile duel he refuses, so spend for sustained damage rather than poke.

keyTips.text: Treat Zeri as weak before level six: stay alive, farm, and take only short trades with empowered W or passive attacks instead of extended fights, rating level one as especially weak and levels two and three as only a small improvement.
Preserve E for escaping or repositioning rather than spending the dash for a small damage increase, and use wall angles to open movement and W paths.
After lane, join teamfights and deal damage instead of farming a wave through an important breaking fight, positioning safely while keeping E available for the moment the fight shifts.

tips.text: Spend W once per wave for waveclear and save further casts for an enemy misposition or allied crowd control that creates a clear follow-up.
Open Doran's Bow by default, switching to Doran's Shield when lane priority is unavailable or the lane is going poorly.
Run Conqueror with Triumph, Legend: Alacrity, Cut Down, Celerity, and Gathering Storm, with attack speed, movement speed, and scaling health shards.
Play around walls: they create better E repositioning and W angles, so use E sparingly and keep it ready as the fight's position changes.
Treat Zeri as burst-oriented in the early and mid game, transitioning toward sustained hypercarry damage as she scales.
Farm through the weak pre-six lane, use the level-six ultimate window to contest fights, then scale into sustained teamfight damage with the crit build.
Keep wall routes for mobility and attack angles, holding E so Zeri can adjust position instead of getting trapped after committing.
Show up to teamfights and maintain damage uptime, choosing safety and useful positioning over an isolated duel.

itemization.text: Build Doran's Bow into Yun Tal Wildarrows, Infinity Edge, Lord Dominik's Regards, Hexoptics C44, and Berserker's Greaves, with Endless Hunger, Bloodthirster, and Guardian Angel as fifth- or sixth-slot options.
Take the safer alternative of Yun Tal Wildarrows, Runaan's Hurricane, Infinity Edge, and Gluttonous Greaves before situational armor penetration and late picks.

Keep Mortal Reminder for armor penetration, Mercurial Scimitar for cleanse, Edge of Night or Serpent's Fang by game, and Zhonya's Hourglass, Maw of Malmortius, Death's Dance, or Spirit Visage as defensive options.
